								3095 text Prompt register:  a prompt-level TF-IDF classifier separates this dataset's  new  prompts from the community reconstructions of the competition's train prompts almost perfectly (AUC ~ 1.0; driven by our format sentences, 'Explain/Describe' openings, 'for a general audience' and second-person modifiers). This is the likely reason one of our blocks was worth only about 0.2-0.25 competition prompts in our own transfer tests. Split  new2  (when present) uses prompts written in the reconstructions' register: style-only (function-word skeleton) AUC 0.76 and full TF-IDF AUC 0.77 against held-out reconstructions (a slot-filling variant that copied reconstruction sentence frames scored 0.81 held-out / 0.60 in-sample and was not used); topics are disjoint from the competition's by design, which keeps the full-text AUC above 0.5. Split  train_regen  (when present) answers the reconstructed train prompts themselves.
